narrative.overview:
This document records the implemented /pricing surface only. It does not replace Home's visual system or authorize applying these tokens to unrelated routes. The supplied React Bits Pricing 14 reference and minimal premium direction inform the restrained package specification and subscription summary.

White space, quiet borders, compact feature rows, and a dark primary action establish hierarchy. Indonesian copy and the Mangelek wordmark anchor the page. Source authority is src/styles/pricing/*.css, src/components/pricing, and the pricing route; the page brief remains in PRICING-DESIGN.md.

Separately scoped authentication, Blogs, and Templates extensions preserve this incumbent system and Home authority; their extensions record their own source and interaction contracts.
keyCharacteristics: A neutral, light surface with restrained functional color.
A single package container and a softly tinted summary.
Responsive ordering, visible keyboard focus, and native disclosures.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply this palette inside /pricing; preserve other routes' existing visual authority.

dos: Do scope this visual system to /pricing.
Do preserve local typography, neutral surfaces, native controls, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain summary-first mobile ordering and wrapping navigation.
donts: Don't apply this page's composition or palette as a global Home redesign.
Don't introduce decorative elevation, animated monetary values, or unverified pricing claims.
Don't describe screenshot review as physical phone QA.
